## Environment constraints (Phase 0)
- node v25.2.1, pnpm 10.32.1, npm 11, docker 29 present.
- **NO aws CLI, NO AWS credentials, NO SST/turbo installed.** turbo/sst will be devDeps.
- H0 human prerequisites (AWS account, domains rhema.app/rhemausercontent.com, Secrets Manager,
  SES prod) NOT done. => Live-deploy ACs cannot be executed here; implement as IaC + defer live proof.

## Requirements (spec §In scope) — working checklist
- [ ] R1 Monorepo layout per §13.2: apps{web,api,collab,worker,run-task,fetcher,convert,egress-proxy,export,mobile}
      + packages{contracts,db,engine,hooks,harness,protocols,protocols-stub,measure,figures,ui,api-client,tokens,findings-core,markdown-view}
      + infra/, evals/, evals-stub/. pnpm workspaces + Turborepo; Bazel-compatible invariants
      (explicit per-pkg deps, project references, NO cross-package relative imports — lint-enforced);
      Turborepo remote cache self-hosted on S3 (never Vercel).
- [ ] R2 Private-package resolution (REQ-ARCH-37 amended): @rhema/protocols and evals/ resolved by
      PATH to a separate private checkout when present, else fallback to packages/protocols-stub /
      evals-stub/. Never git submodules. public-safe CI job builds stub-only.
- [ ] R3 SST v3 stages dev / pr-<n> / prod: prod Aurora >=4 ACU floor; previews 0-ACU auto-pause;
      isolated preview buckets; max_usd-style preview guards as config; VPC private sandbox subnet
      with NO IGW/NAT route (REQ-ARCH-2), subnets /20; IAM as code.
- [ ] R4 Better Auth self-hosted in Postgres: Google OAuth + email magic link; sessions; device list schema stub.
- [ ] R5 CI (GH Actions): typecheck/lint/unit -> contracts -> integration -> images(build+scan,pin digests)
      -> public-safe (gitleaks; protocol-marker grep placeholder; licence allowlist MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD/ISC
      failing SSPL/BSL/AGPL + checked-in exception list w/ rationale: @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk, pandoc, fonts).
      Jobs may be thin placeholders; pipeline + licence/exception docs real now.
- [ ] R6 Deploy provenance (REQ-ARCH-39): every deploy records {git_sha,image_digests,protocols_version,
      rate_table_version} in a deployments table/artifact (schema provisional ok).
- [ ] R7 Repo hygiene (Q-19): MIT LICENSE, SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSES.md; no user text in
      history; secrets only via Secrets Manager/SSM — no secret as env var to web/collab.
- [ ] R8 Backups/retention/deletion (REQ-ARCH-28/29): Aurora continuous backups 35d + S3 versioning as
      config; tombstone->30-day purge->lifecycle-delete pipeline for project deletion + 14-day-grace
      account hard-delete (anonymized ledger rows + Stripe customer retained) as worker jobs; §13.3
      retention schedule (transcripts 30d, internal events 30d, audit 90d, usage/ledger 7y, restore
      points per plan) as lifecycle rules/config.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1 pnpm install && pnpm turbo build lint typecheck green on fresh clone WITHOUT private protocols
      checkout (stub resolution) AND with it. (deterministic) — RUNNABLE here (without private checkout).
- [ ] AC2 sst deploy --stage pr-test stands up isolated preview (0-ACU Aurora, isolated buckets) + tears
      down cleanly; dev deploys skeleton services. (deterministic) — DEFERRED: needs AWS creds/H0.
- [ ] AC3 SG/route-table test: sandbox subnet has no route to IGW/NAT; only egress target is future
      proxy SG (REQ-ARCH-2). (deterministic) — do as static IaC assertion here; live deferred.
- [ ] AC4 CI fails on: SSPL/BSL/AGPL dep not in exception list; a gitleaks hit; a cross-package relative
      import. (deterministic) — RUNNABLE: unit-test the checkers/lint rule locally.
- [ ] AC5 Sign-in with Google and magic link works on dev. (deterministic) — DEFERRED: needs AWS/OAuth/H0.
- [ ] AC6 LICENSES.md lists SDK commercial-terms exception + pandoc/GPL separate-process rationale. (det) — RUNNABLE.
- [ ] AC7 Deletion pipeline test: tombstoned project purges at 30-day mark (clock-advanced fixture);
      retention lifecycle rules exist for each §13.3 class (REQ-ARCH-28/29). — RUNNABLE (unit test purge logic).

## Out of scope (must NOT implement)
- Real schema/contracts (P0.02), skills (P0.03), engine/image (P0.06), proxy logic (P0.07),
  services' business logic (P0.08+), RLS policies (P0.02). Marketing site/landing page.

## Cross-cutting invariants
- TypeScript end-to-end; NO Python anywhere (Q-3).
- Open-source-ready: nothing from packages/protocols or evals/ reachable from a public clone (REQ-ARCH-33/37).

## Plan (Phase 1)
Build order: (1) root workspace foundation (package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, .npmrc, turbo.json,
tsconfig.base.json, eslint flat config + custom rules, prettier, gitleaks). (2) protocols/evals
path-resolution + stubs. (3) all apps+packages stubs (explicit deps, project refs, no cross-pkg
relative imports). (4) infra/sst.config.ts + pure infra/config/stages.ts (testable invariants).
(5) Better Auth + db auth schema stub. (6) CI 5 jobs + pure checker scripts. (7) deploy provenance.
(8) repo hygiene docs. (9) deletion/retention worker jobs + pure purge logic + retention config.
(10) vitest tests for all pure logic.
- Verification target: `pnpm install && pnpm turbo build lint typecheck` at root; `pnpm test`.
- Baseline: empty repo (no prior code) => baseline trivially green.
- Test runner: vitest. Linter: ESLint 9 flat. TS: project references, tsc --build.

## Test matrix (Phase 1.4)  (maps AC -> tests; AWS-live ACs have static/unit proxies)
- T1 (AC4) license-checker: fails SSPL/BSL/AGPL not in exceptions; passes when excepted; passes MIT/Apache/BSD/ISC.
- T2 (AC4) no-cross-package-relative-import ESLint rule via RuleTester (flags ../other-pkg; allows ./local, @rhema/x).
- T3 (AC4) protocol-marker checker flags marker strings; passes clean bundle.
- T4 (AC6) LICENSES.md contains SDK commercial-terms exception + pandoc GPL separate-process rationale (content assertion).
- T5 (AC7) purge decision: tombstone < 30d => keep; >= 30d => purge (clock-advanced fixture).
- T6 (AC7) retention config: a rule exists for each §13.3 class (transcripts30,events30,audit90,usage/ledger7y,restore).
- T7 (AC3) stage config invariants: sandbox subnet has no igw/nat route; egress target = proxy SG only.
- T8 (AC2) stage config: prod Aurora minAcu>=4; preview stage 0-ACU autopause + isolated buckets + max_usd guard.
- T9 (AC1/R2) protocols resolver decision fn: private path present => private; absent => stub.
- T10 (R6) provenance record builder yields {git_sha,image_digests,protocols_version,rate_table_version}.
- T11 (banned-strings) canonical-vocabulary lint rule flags a banned string.
- Deterministic-but-AWS-live (DEFERRED, documented in report): AC2 real sst deploy, AC5 Google/magic-link on dev,
  AC3 live route-table read. Proxied by T7/T8 static IaC-config assertions.

## Gaps closed after independent audit (Phase 4.3)
1. S3 lifecycle bug: one BucketLifecycleConfigurationV2 per class -> collapsed into single resource with rules[].
2. Aurora 35d backup not wired -> added transform.cluster backupRetentionPeriod in sst.config.ts.
3. Provenance never recorded -> scripts/record-provenance.mjs + images CI job records+uploads artifact (verified locally).
4. Deletion "as worker jobs" nominal -> added jobs.ts handlers (handleProjectPurge/handleAccountHardDelete) + jobs.test.ts.
5. AC1 "with private checkout" unverified -> tools/checks/pnpmfile.test.mjs drives real .pnpmfile.cjs against on-disk checkout.
6. .gitignore lacked private-checkout guards -> added packages/protocols/ + evals/ + provenance-artifacts/.
Not-gaps (per spec): images builds run-task/export/fetcher/egress-proxy = exactly §13.2's list.
Accepted-as-skeleton: turbo S3 cache config-only; SST-managed subnets not /20 (sandbox is); IAM via link:.
